seo_copy.long_description: Meet the PulseBeat Pro Wireless Earbuds, the true wireless earbuds customers can't stop talking about. Buyers rate it 3.86 out of 5, and the reason comes up again and again: battery life is insane, i charge the case maybe once a week. In their own words: "battery life is insane". It offers up to 40 hours total playtime with charging case (8 h per charge). It offers 10-minute fast charge gives 2 hours of playback. It offers bluetooth 5.3 with one-tap pairing. It offers quad-mic ENC for clear calls. It offers 40 ms low-latency game mode. It offers iPX5 sweat and splash resistance. It offers touch controls and voice assistant support. Another shopper put it simply: "pairing was instant". Whether you use it every day or only on the weekend, the PulseBeat Pro Wireless Earbuds is built to keep up with real everyday routines, from long commutes to hot summers. At $36, it is priced to make the decision easy. Every order ships with a simple setup guide and our support team is one message away if you need help getting started. Add the PulseBeat Pro Wireless Earbuds to your cart today and see why so many buyers recommend it to friends and family. Check the feature list above, compare it with what you pay elsewhere, and you will see why this is one of the most reviewed products in its category on our store.
